verdict.rationale: Lium's docs describe API keys with scopes that limit what a key can do, fixed at creation, plus per-key daily, monthly and lifetime USD budgets enforced by the server. That directly supports issuing least-privilege credentials to an agent. Missing for 10: an enumerated list of the available scopes and their granularity, and independent or hands-on corroboration that scope enforcement works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: API keys with scopes and per-key daily, monthly and lifetime USD budgets enforced by the server
Scopes limit what a key can do. They are set when you create the key and can't be changed later.
